# Draft:Ishwar Bhati

----
Ishwar Bhati is an Indian basketball coach and physical education teacher based in New Delhi. He is a FIBA-certified basketball coach with over two decades of experience in school and grassroots basketball development.
Bhati has trained more than 500 athletes, several of whom have represented India at national and international levels. He is the founder of the IB Sports Foundation, a non-profit initiative focused on providing basketball training opportunities to underprivileged youth.
Early life and education
Ishwar Bhati developed an early interest in sports and physical education. He pursued formal training in physical education and basketball coaching, later obtaining certification from the International Basketball Federation (FIBA).
Career
Bhati has been associated with school and academy-level basketball coaching for over 20 years. He currently serves as a Physical Education Teacher and National Basketball Coach at ITL Public School, New Delhi.
Over the years, he has coached student-athletes across age groups, focusing on skill development, fitness training, and competitive exposure. Many of his trainees have participated in state, national, and international basketball tournaments.
Bhati has also contributed to grassroots basketball development through training camps, inter-school tournaments, and coaching clinics.
IB Sports Foundation
Bhati is the founder of the IB Sports Foundation, a non-profit initiative aimed at empowering underprivileged children through basketball. The foundation focuses on providing access to structured coaching, sports equipment, and competitive opportunities.
Awards and recognition
* NFPET National Award for Best Coach (2022–23)
* Outstanding Physical Education Teacher Award (2017), awarded by the Action Committee of Unaided Recognized Private Schools
* Selected as Best Coach during the Reliance Foundation Jr. NBA Program (2017–18)
* Invited to an NBA Experience Program in Shanghai, China hosted by NBA representatives
Coaching philosophy
Bhati’s coaching approach emphasizes discipline, physical fitness, and long-term athlete development, combining technical basketball training with teamwork and leadership skills.
